thread:
Sam R: FYI noticing elevated 502s for hosted-api-usw2 around 02:01 PDT. Appears to correlate with large batched uploads from a few customers.
Jordan (oncall): joining. how widespread?
Sam R: primarily hosted-api-usw2, ~12 customers, heavy for embed/upload endpoints.
Priya (netops): seeing short-lived NAT translation table exhaustion on natgw-7 (conntrack retries). Auto-scaling didn't trigger because conntracking reached quota.
Infra Team: opened a cloud case to increase conntrack quota + provision additional NAT instances. ETA 20m.
CS Bot: queued messages to affected customers: brief notice + suggested retry/backoff.
Jordan (oncall): immediate mitigation: applied connection TTL reduction and enabled aggressive TCP_FIN cleanup on affected nodes to free conntrack slots. Rolling change to 10 hosts now.
Sam R: can you add temporary per-connection upload size cap at the LB for hosted-api to limit single-flow pressure?
Priya (netops): added LB policy clip-upload-size=200MB for streaming/upload routes. Canary 2 hosts, looks ok.
SRE Bot: [METRIC] 502s hosted-api-usw2: 02:05 150/min -> 02:20 48/min -> 02:55 5/min.
Infra Team: cloud confirmed quota bump +2 NATs at 02:42, conntrack freed and utilization normalized.
Jordan (oncall): roll changes to remaining nodes complete at 02:50. 502s back to baseline.
Sam R: marking as mitigated. next steps: 1) postmortem to document conntrack limits and LB caps, 2) add CI lint to reject deploys that change long-lived connection behavior without traffic test, 3) customer comms for any persistent issues.
Priya (netops): opening issue for autoscale policy to consider conntrack saturation as a scaling signal.
CS Bot: all flagged customers acknowledged notices; one requested temporary quota while they adjust batching.
Jordan (oncall): incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1827002468 and status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1827002468
SRE Bot: [CLOSED] Incident mitigated at 02:52 PDT.
Sam R: thanks all. Postmortem review scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
